Booking and payment

Reserve in three simple steps

Pay securely by UPI from any app. Your booking is confirmed on WhatsApp once we receive the 50% advance. You can also fill our booking and registration forms online, below.

  1. Check availability

    Send your dates and room choice on WhatsApp using the booking bar above, or call +91 75011 01137.

  2. Pay the 50% advance

    Once we confirm the room is free, pay half of the total room price online, by UPI or by bank transfer. Scan the QR code or pay to our UPI ID from Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm or any bank app.

  3. Send the payment screenshot

    Share the screenshot on WhatsApp. We send your booking confirmation right away. The balance is paid at check-in.

Advance and cancellation policy

Simple, fair and clear

A 50% advance holds your room for you. The balance is paid at check-in.

3 or more days before check-inFull refund of your advanceFor a 20 Nov check-in, cancel on or before 17 Nov.
Less than 3 days before, on the day of arrival, or no-showThe advance is not refundedThe room was held for you and turned away other guests.
How to cancel
Send a WhatsApp message to +91 75011 01137 or an email to nikadiguesthouse@gmail.com with your name, booking reference and dates. The time we receive your message is your cancellation time, and we reply to confirm it.
Refunds
The full advance goes back to the same UPI ID or bank account you paid from.
Changing dates
The advance is for the dates you booked and cannot be moved to other dates. To change dates, cancel 3 or more days before check-in for a full refund, then make a new booking.
If we have to cancel
In the rare case that we cannot give you the room, we refund your full advance.

Questions

Good to know

What are the check-in and check-out times?
Check-in is from 11:00 AM and check-out is by 9:00 AM. Gold members and above get early check-in from 9 AM when the room is available.
How do I confirm my booking?
Send your dates on WhatsApp or use the booking bar at the top. Once we confirm the room is available, pay a 50% advance by UPI, card or bank transfer. The balance is paid at check-in. See how to book and pay.
Can I cancel?
Yes. Cancel 3 or more days before check-in and we refund your full advance. Less than 3 days before, on the day of arrival or a no-show is not refunded. Read the full policy.
Do you serve food?
We are room only, so meals are not served. Govinda's in the ISKCON campus is a 10 minute walk, and there are prasadam stalls right outside our door. Drinking water is provided.
How many guests can stay in a room?
Each Deluxe Double and Deluxe Twin room takes up to 3 guests. For groups and festival dates, message us and we will plan the rooms for you.
Is the guest house vegetarian?
Yes. Out of respect for Sri Dham Mayapur, no non-veg food, eggs, smoking, tobacco or alcohol are allowed on the premises. There is a ₹2,000 fine for any violation.
Where exactly is the reception?
On the first floor. Enter at the left corner of the building, by the picture of Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, and take the stairs up. Watch the walk-up video.
What is Nikadi Membership?
A free membership for guests who come back. You get 100 welcome points, 5–20% off every booking, and free nights with your points. See the levels.

Terms & Conditions of Stay
Smoke-free · Tobacco-free · Alcohol-free property Smoking of cigarettes or bidis, use of tobacco, and consumption of gutka, pan, pan masala or alcohol are strictly prohibited in all areas of the property, including guest rooms, balconies, corridors and common areas. Any violation will attract an immediate fine of ₹2,000.
  1. IdentificationA valid government-issued photo ID is mandatory for every guest, including accompanying guests. Foreign nationals must present a passport and valid visa.
  2. Arrival & departureCheck-in from 11:00 AM and check-out by 9:00 AM. Early arrival and late departure are subject to availability and may be charged.
  3. VisitorsOnly registered guests may stay overnight. Visitors are welcome in the reception area only.
  4. PaymentThe room tariff is payable in advance at check-in. All incidental charges are to be settled before departure.
  5. Dietary observanceOut of respect for the sanctity of Sri Dham Mayapur, non-vegetarian food and eggs are not permitted on the premises.
  6. In-room safetyCooking is not permitted in rooms. Heaters, irons and other high-power appliances may be used only with the approval of the Front Office.
  7. Quiet hoursGuests are requested to keep noise to a minimum, particularly between 10:00 pm and 6:00 am.
  8. Property careAny damage to rooms, furnishings, linen or fittings will be charged to the guest at actual cost.
  9. ValuablesGuests are responsible for their own cash, jewellery and belongings. The management accepts no liability for loss or theft.
  10. Energy & keysPlease switch off lights, fans and air-conditioning when leaving the room, and deposit the room key at the Front Office.
  11. Restricted itemsPets, weapons and illegal substances are not permitted. Any unlawful activity will be reported to the authorities.
  12. Right of admissionThe management reserves the right to refuse or terminate a stay, without refund, in case of misconduct or breach of these terms.
